text:
elaine-finance: Heads up — Quantiva (private deploy) got a midterm support-tier downgrade on 2026-03-10 but we billed full-year platform fee. Invoice INV-98122 is out. Can we do a proration + true-up? Need final adjustment before renewal email tomorrow.

miguel-billing: Can you paste the change SOW date and the new support tier? I want to pull metering for onprem vCPU hours and platform-fee line items.

elaine-finance: Change effective 2026-03-10, support moved from Enterprise+ to Standard. SOW id SOW-QL-334. Platform fee should be prorated from Enterprise+ → Standard for remaining 9.6 months.

ryan-cs: Customer confirmed downgrade due to feature scope. They asked for a credit instead of a reissue so accountants can reconcile on their side.

miguel-billing: Ok grabbing usage. billing-bot: Generated metering export for customer Quantiva: /exports/quantiva_214500_batch.csv

billing-bot: CSV preview: 
```
date,resource,units,charge_usd
2026-02-01,onprem_vcpu_hours,4320,0
2026-03-01,onprem_vcpu_hours,1200,0
2026-03-10,platform_fee,1,60000
```

ian-legal: We need an approval note on record: credit amount, reason (midterm tier downgrade), and sign-off from finance lead. Also check whether platform-fee refund triggers reseller commission clawback.

elaine-finance: Draft calc: Enterprise+ platform fee annual = $60,000, Standard = $36,000, difference = $24,000 yearly. Prorate remaining 9.6/12 => credit = $19,200. Customer asked for rounding down to $18,400 to avoid commission recalc. Need approval to post $18,400 credit and mark as final settlement.

miguel-billing: I can provision provisional credit memo for $18,400 and stop collections. Will hold until Manu signs. Also will flag reseller commission — note: reseller commission team needs separate note to avoid double clawback.

sophie-account: I'm on SL with the customer — they'll accept $18.4k if we include a short release note. Please include statement "final settlement for platform fee difference due to midterm support tier change".

manu-cfo: Approved. Manu-cfo: :ok_hand: Sign-off on $18,400 credit and release note. Proceed to issue credit memo and update AR.

miguel-billing: Done — created credit memo CM-214500-01 for $18,400, marked final settlement. Notified reseller ops to suspend commission clawback for this case. Posting to AR today.

elaine-finance: Thanks all. I'll send the release note to Quantiva and file the adjustment memo under SOW-QL-334. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
